entries.title: Acolyte
entries.summary: A religious scholar or temple servant whose background supports Wisdom, sacred learning, and introductory divine magic.
entries.description: The Acolyte background provides three eligible ability scores, a specific Origin feat, two skill proficiencies, a tool proficiency, and a choice between listed equipment or 50 GP. When assigning background ability increases, use the 2024 character-creation rules.

facts.label: Equipment Choice
facts.value: Calligrapher’s Supplies, prayer book, Holy Symbol, 10 sheets of parchment, robe, and 8 GP; or 50 GP

traits.name: Background Ability Scores
traits.description: Increase one listed ability score by 2 and another by 1, or increase all three listed ability scores by 1, following the 2024 character-creation rules.

traits.name: Origin Feat
traits.description: You gain Magic Initiate (Cleric) as part of this background.
